choice.description: Does the response fully and correctly satisfy every explicit requirement in the request? Judge the derivation, code, result, and formatting, not merely whether the final number looks plausible. Rubric — false: The response contains any substantive error or misses an explicit constraint.; true: The response is fully correct and satisfies every explicit constraint..

contexts: {"request": "A Berlin office schedules a call for 09:15 local time on 27 October 2024. Convert it to UTC. State whether daylight saving time is in effect at that instant and give the applicable UTC offset. Europe/Berlin follows the EU transition, with clocks moving from 03:00 CEST to 02:00 CET that morning.\n\nAdditional evaluation context: The meeting record is used by colleagues outside Europe, so an unexplained local timestamp is not acceptable. Use the transition fact supplied here rather than assuming that the entire date has one offset. There is no ambiguity from the repeated early-morning hour because the stated appointment occurs well after that interval. The answer will be reviewed as a complete handoff, so correctness of intermediate reasoning, units, boundary conventions, and every stated presentation constraint matters independently of whether the concluding value appears plausible.", "response": "The rollback has already occurred by 09:15 local time, so daylight saving time is no longer in effect. Europe/Berlin is then CET, UTC+01:00. Subtracting one hour, the call is at **08:15 UTC on 27 October 2024**."}
